notes: Do NOT use Corepack on Hostinger — it fails with ERR_VM_DYNAMIC_IMPORT_CALLBACK_MISSING. Use installCommand above. If hPanel has separate Install/Build fields: Install = node scripts/hostinger-install.mjs, Build = HOSTINGER_SKIP_INSTALL=1 node scripts/hostinger-build.mjs. Or use a single Build command: node scripts/hostinger-build.mjs
